title: tok: a textual concrete syntax of BPMN and DMN for humans and AI agents
title_zh: tok：一种面向人类和AI智能体的BPMN与DMN文本具体语法

paragraphs.en: tok is a plain-text notation for Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2 process models and Decision Model and Notation (DMN) 1.5 decisions. One engine checks a tok document against both standards, compiles the document to XML with an automatic diagram, and serves language-model applications through the Model Context Protocol. The paper classifies the notation as an alternative concrete syntax of the BPMN and DMN metamodels and reports one study. A tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 files exported by 37 tools and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported. The checker signals 98.2% of 1 411 injected faults, against 85.8% for the XML Schema with bpmnlint. Four language models new to tok write valid tok from a one-page reference for 85.7 to 100% of 87 process descriptions from two datasets and valid BPMN XML for every description, and the strongest model writes tok with 25% and 19% fewer tokens than BPMN XML. As agents with a lean skill and one checker tool, the models write valid tok for 97.6 to 100% of the descriptions, the strongest model spends 21% and 14% fewer tokens on tok than on BPMN XML, and a skill which sends the model to read the reference through a tool costs 1.7 to 2.8 times the tokens of the lean skill. Of 47 event logs simulated from public models, 44 fit their source models, and tok imports every model discovered from the logs.
paragraphs.zh: tok 是一种用于业务流程模型与标记（BPMN）2.0.2 流程模型以及决策模型与标记（DMN）1.5 决策的纯文本表示法。 一个引擎可依据这两项标准对 tok 文档进行检查，将文档编译为带自动生成图的 XML，并通过模型上下文协议为语言模型应用提供服务。 本文将该表示法归类为 BPMN 与 DMN 元模型的一种替代性具体语法，并报告了一项研究。 对于 37 种工具导出的 893 个文件中最小的 BPMN XML，一个 tok 模型所用的标记少 2.2 倍；与这些文件原样导出的结果相比，则少 7.7 倍。 检查器能检出 1411 个注入故障中的 98.2%，而配合 bpmnlint 的 XML Schema 检出率为 85.8%。 四个此前未接触过 tok 的语言模型，仅凭一页参考文档，就能为来自两个数据集的 87 个流程描述中的 85.7% 至 100% 写出有效的 tok，并为每个描述写出有效的 BPMN XML；其中最强的模型写 tok 所用标记比 BPMN XML 分别少 25% 和 19%。 作为配备精简技能和一个检查器工具的智能体，这些模型能为 97.6% 至 100% 的描述写出有效的 tok，最强的模型在 tok 上花费的标记比在 BPMN XML 上分别少 21% 和 14%，而让智能体通过工具阅读参考文档的技能所耗标记是精简技能的 1.7 至 2.8 倍。 在从公开模型模拟出的 47 个事件日志中，有 44 个与各自的源模型相吻合，并且 tok 能够导入从这些日志中发现的每一个模型。

paragraphs.en: Organisations keep models of their processes as information objects, which document work, support analysis and compliance, configure process engines and teach students how work is organised ( Dumas et al., 2018 ) . Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) 2.0.2 is the standard notation for process models, with an XML format for the exchange of models and their diagrams between tools ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) , and Decision Model and Notation (DMN) 1.5 is the companion standard for the decisions taken inside processes ( Object Management Group, 2024 ) . Practice uses a small part of the BPMN vocabulary, as zur Muehlen and Recker (2008) found that a few core constructs account for most of the elements in the models of their sample, and a survey of practitioners reports the uptake of the notation together with the difficulties of its users ( Recker, 2010 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 组织机构将流程模型保存为信息对象，用于记录工作、支持分析与合规、配置流程引擎，以及教导学生了解工作是如何组织的（Dumas 等，2018）。 业务流程模型与标记法（BPMN）2.0.2 是流程模型的标准标记法，其 XML 格式用于在工具之间交换模型及其图形（对象管理组织，2014），而决策模型与标记法（DMN）1.5 是与之配套的标准，用于描述流程中所做的决策（对象管理组织，2024）。 实践中只使用 BPMN 词汇的一小部分，正如 zur Muehlen 和 Recker（2008）所发现的那样，少数核心构造占了其样本模型中大多数元素，而一项针对从业者的调查报告了该标记法的采用情况以及用户遇到的困难（Recker，2010）。

paragraphs.en: A process model has three readers with different needs. A person reads a diagram and changes the model in a tool, a process engine and an exchange partner read the XML file, and a language model, the newest reader, writes and reads whatever text the prompt contains. The exchange format serves the second reader, because a correct file needs unique identifiers, references in both directions between nodes and flows, the element order of the schema and, for a diagram, the coordinates of every shape and every bend of an edge. People therefore read, review and compare the files with difficulty, since reading a notation is a skill of its own ( Petre, 1995 ) and the comprehension of a process description depends on the notation and on the training of the reader ( Ottensooser et al., 2012 ; Figl, 2017 ) , and a version-control difference of a small change to a drawn model consists mostly of geometry, a known cost of versioning graphical models ( Altmanninger et al., 2009 ) . The third reader meets the same cost, in that a model written from scratch in BPMN XML spends most of its output on syntax and references and valid BPMN XML remains a hurdle for open models ( Lauer et al., 2026 ) , and research on process modelling with language models therefore works through intermediate representations, for example process code in the POWL language translated to BPMN by a converter ( Kourani et al., 2024 ) , and evaluates conversational modelling and process tasks ( Klievtsova et al., 2023 ; Grohs et al., 2024 ) . The intermediate representations serve the model, while the person keeps the diagram and the file, so that the three readers of one process still hold three artefacts.
paragraphs.zh: 一个流程模型有三位需求各异的读者。 一个人阅读图并在工具中修改模型，一个流程引擎和交换伙伴读取 XML 文件，而语言模型——最新的读者——则读写提示词所包含的任意文本。 交换格式服务于第二位读者，因为一个正确的文件需要唯一的标识符、节点与流之间双向的引用、模式所规定的元素顺序，并且对于图而言，还需要每个形状的坐标以及边的每个拐点的坐标。 因此人们阅读、审阅和比较这些文件都很困难，因为阅读一种表示法本身就是一项技能（Petre, 1995），而对流程描述的理解取决于表示法以及读者的训练程度（Ottensooser et al., 2012; Figl, 2017），并且对绘制模型做微小修改所产生的版本控制差异主要由几何信息构成，这是对图形模型进行版本管理的一个已知代价（Altmanninger et al., 2009）。 第三位读者也面临同样的代价，因为用 BPMN XML 从零编写一个模型时，其大部分输出都耗费在语法和引用上，而有效的 BPMN XML 对开放模型来说依然是一道障碍（Lauer et al., 2026），因此关于使用语言模型进行流程建模的研究通过中间表示来展开，例如 POWL 语言中的流程代码经转换器转换为 BPMN（Kourani et al., 2024），并对会话式建模和流程任务进行评估（Klievtsova et al., 2023; Grohs et al., 2024）。 中间表示服务于模型，而人则保存图和文件，因此同一流程的三位读者仍然持有三个不同的制品。

paragraphs.en: tok is a plain-text notation for the content of BPMN 2.0.2 and DMN 1.5, written for the three readers at once. A tok document states pools, lanes, events, activities, gateways, sequence and message flows, data, decisions, forms and simulation parameters in short lines, one statement per line, and one engine compiles the document to BPMN XML with an automatic diagram layout, SVG pictures, DMN files, Camunda 8 forms and simulated event logs. The engine reads BPMN and DMN files drawn in other tools and prints the files as tok, checks documents and BPMN files against the rules of both standards, and offers the same operations to language-model applications through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ( Model Context Protocol, 2025 ) . The proposition behind the design is that one symbolic notation over the metamodel of the standard, with a checker which answers every text with a diagnostic at the line and the element concerned, serves as the shared code of a person, a tool and a language model, so that the document which the person keeps is the text which the model writes, and the file which the tool reads is compiled from both.
paragraphs.zh: tok 是一种用于 BPMN 2.0.2 和 DMN 1.5 内容的纯文本表示法，为三类读者同时而写。 tok 文档以简短的行来陈述池、泳道、事件、活动、网关、顺序流与消息流、数据、决策、表单和仿真参数，每行一条语句，一个引擎将文档编译为带有自动图布局的 BPMN XML、SVG 图片、DMN 文件、Camunda 8 表单以及模拟的事件日志。 该引擎读取在其他工具中绘制的 BPMN 和 DMN 文件并将其打印为 tok，依据两个标准的规则检查文档和 BPMN 文件，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器向语言模型应用提供相同的操作（Model Context Protocol, 2025）。 该设计背后的主张是：在标准的元模型之上的一种符号表示法，配上一个对每段文本都能在相关行和元素处给出诊断的检查器，可作为人、工具与语言模型的共享代码，从而人保存的文档就是模型书写的文本，而工具读取的文件则由二者编译而来。

paragraphs.en: The paper makes four contributions, and the first contribution is the notation and its engine, described as a design which covers the syntax, the levels and conformance classes, the checker and the interfaces, and which shows how a textual notation stays exact against two standards. The second contribution is a classification of tok in formal language theory, model-driven engineering, semiotics and the theory of communication, which explains why the translation between tok and the standards is exact and why the diagnostics of the checker work as common ground between a writer and the engine. The third contribution is one study with six measurements, namely the size of tok against BPMN XML in the tokens that language models read, the detection of injected modelling faults, the writing of process models by four language models from two sets of texts, a process-mining demonstration, the speed of the engine and its conformance suites, which together put numbers on the price and the benefit of the notation for each of the three readers. The fourth contribution consists of the material of the study, which makes the software, the data and the scripts available for further work. The results support the proposition in measured terms, in that a tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 tool files and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported, the checker signals 98.2 % of 1 411 injected faults against 85.8 % for the XML validators. Four language models which meet tok for the first time write valid tok from one page of reference for 85.7 to 100 % of 87 texts, with 25 % and 19 % fewer tokens than BPMN XML for the strongest model; as agents with a lean skill and one checker tool the models write valid tok for 97.6 to 100 % of the texts, and the strongest model spends 21 % and 14 % fewer tokens on tok than the same agent spends on BPMN XML; and 44 of 47 event logs simulated from public models fit their source models under replay.
paragraphs.zh: 本文有四项贡献，第一项贡献是记法及其引擎，其设计涵盖语法、层级与一致性类别、检查器和接口，并展示了文本记法如何对照两项标准保持精确。 第二项贡献是对 tok 在形式语言理论、模型驱动工程、符号学与传播理论中的分类，它解释了 tok 与标准之间为何能够精确转换，以及检查器的诊断为何能作为撰写者与引擎之间的共同基础。 第三项贡献是一项包含六项测量的研究，即 tok 相对于 BPMN XML 在语言模型读取的词元数量上的规模、对注入建模错误的检测、由四个语言模型根据两组文本撰写过程模型、一次过程挖掘演示、引擎及其一致性测试套件的速度，这些测量共同为三类读者量化了该记法的代价与收益。 第四项贡献由研究材料构成，它将软件、数据和脚本公开，供进一步研究使用。 结果以量化的方式支持了该主张：在 893 个工具文件中最小的 BPMN XML 相比，tok 模型所耗词元少 2.2 倍，相比按原样导出的文件少 7.7 倍；检查器对 1411 个注入错误标出了 98.2%，而 XML 验证器为 85.8%。 四个首次接触 tok 的语言模型仅凭一页参考文档，就能在 87 篇文本中的 85.7% 至 100% 上写出有效的 tok，其中最强模型比 BPMN XML 少用 25% 和 19% 的词元；作为带有精简技能和一个检查器工具的智能体，各模型在 97.6% 至 100% 的文本上写出有效的 tok，且最强模型在 tok 上比同一智能体在 BPMN XML 上少花费 21% 和 14% 的词元；由公开模型模拟出的 47 份事件日志中有 44 份在回放时与其源模型相符。

sents.zh: 本文有四项贡献，第一项贡献是记法及其引擎，其设计涵盖语法、层级与一致性类别、检查器和接口，并展示了文本记法如何对照两项标准保持精确。

sents.en: The second contribution is a classification of tok in formal language theory, model-driven engineering, semiotics and the theory of communication, which explains why the translation between tok and the standards is exact and why the diagnostics of the checker work as common ground between a writer and the engine.
sents.zh: 第二项贡献是对 tok 在形式语言理论、模型驱动工程、符号学与传播理论中的分类，它解释了 tok 与标准之间为何能够精确转换，以及检查器的诊断为何能作为撰写者与引擎之间的共同基础。

sents.en: The third contribution is one study with six measurements, namely the size of tok against BPMN XML in the tokens that language models read, the detection of injected modelling faults, the writing of process models by four language models from two sets of texts, a process-mining demonstration, the speed of the engine and its conformance suites, which together put numbers on the price and the benefit of the notation for each of the three readers.
sents.zh: 第三项贡献是一项包含六项测量的研究，即 tok 相对于 BPMN XML 在语言模型读取的词元数量上的规模、对注入建模错误的检测、由四个语言模型根据两组文本撰写过程模型、一次过程挖掘演示、引擎及其一致性测试套件的速度，这些测量共同为三类读者量化了该记法的代价与收益。

sents.en: The fourth contribution consists of the material of the study, which makes the software, the data and the scripts available for further work.
sents.zh: 第四项贡献由研究材料构成，它将软件、数据和脚本公开，供进一步研究使用。

sents.en: The results support the proposition in measured terms, in that a tok model takes 2.2 times fewer tokens than the smallest BPMN XML of 893 tool files and 7.7 times fewer than the files as exported, the checker signals 98.2 % of 1 411 injected faults against 85.8 % for the XML validators.
sents.zh: 结果以量化的方式支持了该主张：在 893 个工具文件中最小的 BPMN XML 相比，tok 模型所耗词元少 2.2 倍，相比按原样导出的文件少 7.7 倍；检查器对 1411 个注入错误标出了 98.2%，而 XML 验证器为 85.8%。

sents.en: Four language models which meet tok for the first time write valid tok from one page of reference for 85.7 to 100 % of 87 texts, with 25 % and 19 % fewer tokens than BPMN XML for the strongest model; as agents with a lean skill and one checker tool the models write valid tok for 97.6 to 100 % of the texts, and the strongest model spends 21 % and 14 % fewer tokens on tok than the same agent spends on BPMN XML; and 44 of 47 event logs simulated from public models fit their source models under replay.
sents.zh: 四个首次接触 tok 的语言模型仅凭一页参考文档，就能在 87 篇文本中的 85.7% 至 100% 上写出有效的 tok，其中最强模型比 BPMN XML 少用 25% 和 19% 的词元；作为带有精简技能和一个检查器工具的智能体，各模型在 97.6% 至 100% 的文本上写出有效的 tok，且最强模型在 tok 上比同一智能体在 BPMN XML 上少花费 21% 和 14% 的词元；由公开模型模拟出的 47 份事件日志中有 44 份在回放时与其源模型相符。

paragraphs.en: BPMN 2.0.2 defines a metamodel of process models, a graphical notation, execution semantics for a part of the metamodel, and an XML format with a schema for the exchange of models, in which a separate diagram interchange part stores the position of every shape and every edge ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) , and DMN 1.5 defines decision requirements graphs, decision tables and boxed expressions with the expression language FEEL, with an XML format of the same construction ( Object Management Group, 2024 ) . The separation of the model from the picture in both standards has a consequence for the design of any further notation, because a file without diagram interchange is a complete model under the standard, so that a notation may carry the model alone and leave the picture to a layout algorithm without any loss against the standard. tok rests on the separation, in that the text holds the model and the engine computes the drawing.
paragraphs.zh: BPMN 2.0.2 定义了过程模型的元模型、一种图形表示法、元模型中一部分内容的执行语义，以及一种带有模型交换所用 XML 模式的 XML 格式，其中单独的图表交换部分存储每个形状和每条边的位置（Object Management Group, 2014）；DMN 1.5 则定义了决策需求图、决策表以及配合表达式语言 FEEL 使用的框式表达式，并带有以相同方式构造的 XML 格式（Object Management Group, 2024）。 这两项标准都将模型与图形分离，这对任何后续表示法的设计产生了影响，因为按照标准，一个不含图表交换信息的文件仍是一个完整的模型，因此一种表示法可以只承载模型本身，而把图形留给布局算法生成，相对于标准不会有任何损失。tok 正是基于这种分离：文本承载模型，引擎负责计算绘制。

(2018) found that modelling tools and engines differ in the parts of BPMN 2.0 which are supported and in the files which are written for the same model, and the Model Interchange Working Group collects the files that modelling tools export for a set of reference models in a public test suite, because interchange between tools fails often enough to need such a test ( OMG BPMN Model Interchange Working Group, 2026 ) . A notation which claims an exact translation to the standard therefore has to be measured against the files that tools write, and the study takes 893 files of 37 tools from the suite for the purpose.

paragraphs.en: The vocabulary of BPMN is large and the use of the vocabulary is concentrated. zur Muehlen and Recker (2008) found that a small set of constructs accounts for most of the elements in the models of their sample and that many constructs are rarely used, guidelines for modelling recommend small models with few elements ( Mendling et al., 2010 ) , and the formal semantics of BPMN through Petri nets shows where the informal semantics of the standard leaves cases open ( Dijkman et al., 2008 ) . The concentration sets two requirements for a notation at once, since a reference of one page can cover the core that writers use, whereas a notation which promises a round trip with tool files has to cover the whole metamodel, and tok meets both requirements with a one-page reference, which the study gives to the language models, and a vocabulary of language 1.0 which spans BPMN 2.0.2 and DMN 1.5.
paragraphs.zh: BPMN 的词汇量很大，而词汇的使用却较为集中。zur Muehlen 和 Recker（2008）发现，在其样本模型中的大部分元素仅由一小部分构造（construct）构成，而许多构造很少被使用；建模指南也推荐使用元素较少的小型模型（Mendling 等，2010）；此外，通过 Petri 网对 BPMN 形式语义的研究表明，该标准的非形式语义在哪些情况下存在未定义之处（Dijkman 等，2008）。 这种集中性同时给表示法提出了两个要求：一页篇幅的参考文档即可覆盖作者们实际使用的核心内容，而承诺与工具文件实现双向转换的表示法则必须覆盖整个元模型。tok 通过一页参考文档（研究将其提供给语言模型）以及横跨 BPMN 2.0.2 和 DMN 1.5 的语言 1.0 词汇表，同时满足了这两个要求。

paragraphs.en: Textual notations for process models occupy three positions, which differ in what the text stands for. In diagram languages such as Mermaid and PlantUML the text stands for a picture, and BPMN Sketch Miner derives BPMN diagrams from a compact outline of activities and actors, which shows that a short text suffices for sketching a process and delivers the diagram as the product ( Ivanchikj et al., 2020 ) . In POWL the text is code for a partially ordered workflow, sound by construction and converted to BPMN or to Petri nets ( Kourani and van Zelst, 2023 ) , and in the model-driven engineering of Drave et al. (2022) a textual BPMN language with a soundness checker serves the generation of code for process-aware information systems. In BPCF, the third position, the text is a notation designed for language models to write, lossless for the constructs of the PMo benchmark and compared with Mermaid, JSON and BPMN XML in tokens, cost and accuracy across five language models ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 流程模型的文本表示法占据三种位置，它们的区别在于文本所代表的内容。 在 Mermaid 和 PlantUML 等图表语言中，文本代表一幅图，而 BPMN Sketch Miner 则从活动与参与者的紧凑大纲推导出 BPMN 图，这表明一段简短的文本足以勾勒流程，并交付作为成品的图（Ivanchikj et al., 2020）。 在 POWL 中，文本是偏序工作流的代码，其构造即保证合理性，并可转换为 BPMN 或 Petri 网（Kourani and van Zelst, 2023）；而在 Drave et al. （2022）的模型驱动工程中，一种带合理性检查器的文本化 BPMN 语言用于为流程感知信息系统生成代码。 在 BPCF（第三种位置）中，文本是一种专为语言模型书写而设计的表示法，对 PMo 基准的结构无损，并与 Mermaid、JSON 和 BPMN XML 在五个语言模型上就令牌数、成本和准确率进行了比较（Agrawal et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: tok takes a position defined by the metamodel of the standard. Among the design decisions for domain-specific languages, the reuse of an existing abstract syntax under a new concrete syntax keeps the semantics of the host and limits the new work to the mapping ( Mernik et al., 2005 ) , and tok applies the decision to the BPMN and DMN metamodels, so that the text covers both metamodels, the checker applies the rules of the standards, an imported tool file prints as tok and exports back, and the same text serves a person as a document. The position has a measurable price and a measurable benefit, which the study reports as the size of the text against the XML of tool files, the fidelity of the round trip, and the detection of faults by the checker.
paragraphs.zh: tok 采取由该标准的元模型所定义的立场。 在领域特定语言的设计决策中，在新具体语法下复用现有抽象语法可保留宿主语言的语义，并将新工作限定在映射上（Mernik et al., 2005），tok 将该决策应用于 BPMN 和 DMN 元模型，使得文本覆盖两个元模型、检查器应用该标准的规则、导入的工具文件以 tok 打印并可导回，以及同一文本对人员而言可作为文档。 该立场具有可衡量的代价和可衡量的收益，本研究通过文本相对于工具文件 XML 的大小、往返的保真度以及检查器对错误的检测来报告这些代价与收益。

paragraphs.en: The generation of process models from text has moved from rules to language models, and the representation that the model writes has become a variable of the research. Rule-based pipelines produced BPMN models from text ( Friedrich et al., 2011 ) , the PET dataset supplied annotated descriptions for the evaluation of extraction methods ( Bellan et al., 2022 ; Bellan et al., 2023 ) , and large language models opened a direct route from text to model together with a list of open questions for process management ( Vidgof et al., 2023 ) . The direct route runs into the exchange format, since a benchmark of 17 open models found valid BPMN XML a major hurdle ( Lauer et al., 2026 ) , and the field answers with intermediate representations, such as POWL code with a converter and a loop of error feedback in ProMoAI ( Kourani et al., 2024 ; Kourani et al., 2026 ) , a JSON layer in BPMN Assistant ( Licardo et al., 2026 ) , a Python-like representation compiled to BPMN and DMN in FLOW-BENCH ( Duesterwald et al., 2025 ) , formal steps after the model in the pipeline of Nivon and Salaün (2025) , and instruction tuning of open-weight models on pairs of text and model ( Çelikmasat et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从文本生成过程模型的方法已经从规则演进到语言模型，而模型所写出的表示形式已成为研究中的一个变量。 基于规则的流水线从文本生成 BPMN 模型（Friedrich 等，2011），PET 数据集为抽取方法的评估提供了带标注的描述（Bellan 等，2022；Bellan 等，2023），而大型语言模型则开辟了从文本到模型的直接路径，同时也带来了一系列过程管理领域的开放性问题（Vidgof 等，2023）。 这条直接路径却卡在交换格式上：一项针对 17 个开放模型的基准测试发现，生成有效的 BPMN XML 是一大障碍（Lauer 等，2026），而该领域的回应是采用中间表示，例如 ProMoAI 中带有转换器和错误反馈循环的 POWL 代码（Kourani 等，2024；Kourani 等，2026）、BPMN Assistant 中的 JSON 层（Licardo 等，2026）、FLOW-BENCH 中编译为 BPMN 和 DMN 的类 Python 表示（Duesterwald 等，2025）、Nivon 和 Salaün（2025）流水线中在模型之后的形式化步骤，以及基于文本与模型配对数据对开放权重模型进行的指令微调（Çelikmasat 等，2025）。

sents.zh: 这条直接路径却卡在交换格式上：一项针对 17 个开放模型的基准测试发现，生成有效的 BPMN XML 是一大障碍（Lauer 等，2026），而该领域的回应是采用中间表示，例如 ProMoAI 中带有转换器和错误反馈循环的 POWL 代码（Kourani 等，2024；Kourani 等，2026）、BPMN Assistant 中的 JSON 层（Licardo 等，2026）、FLOW-BENCH 中编译为 BPMN 和 DMN 的类 Python 表示（Duesterwald 等，2025）、Nivon 和 Salaün（2025）流水线中在模型之后的形式化步骤，以及基于文本与模型配对数据对开放权重模型进行的指令微调（Çelikmasat 等，2025）。

(2026) compared nine representations on 55 descriptions and found Mermaid best overall, a compact intermediate format cut the tokens of conversational modelling against ProMoAI ( Köpke and Safan, 2025 ) , studies of conversational modelling measured the quality of models built in dialogue ( Klievtsova et al., 2023 ) , and Grohs et al. (2024) evaluated language models on the extraction of imperative and of declarative models and on the assessment of tasks for automation. Outside process modelling, the format of a prompt alone changes the performance of a model ( He et al., 2024 ) . The representations in the studies named are built for the model, with the person reading a converted diagram, and the quality criteria differ between the studies, from the similarity of elements to the validity of the XML. The study of tok therefore judges both representations with one external judge, the OMG schema and the correctness rules of bpmnlint, on four models of three families and two datasets, and the representation under test is the document which the person keeps.

paragraphs.en: The behaviour of a language model with tools depends on the interface of the tools and on the feedback which the tools return, and both are design choices of the environment. A model which interleaves reasoning with calls to tools corrects course from observations ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , a model can learn when and how to call a tool ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , surveys of tool learning catalogue the forms which the interface takes ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , feedback from execution lets a model repair its own output ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , and in software engineering the design of the interface between the agent and the computer, with concise feedback and guard rails, decides what the same model achieves ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . The Model Context Protocol standardises how an application offers tools, resources and prompts to a model ( Model Context Protocol, 2025 ) , and the ecosystem of servers raises questions of security and maintenance ( Hou et al., 2025 ) . For a notation which a model meets for the first time, the findings turn the question of learnability into a question about the feedback channel, that is whether a page of reference with the messages of a checker suffices for valid models, and what a skill document and tools called by the model add, at what price in tokens. The study answers the question by treating the two channels as conditions of one design under the same judge.
paragraphs.zh: 带工具的语言模型的行为取决于工具的接口以及工具返回的反馈，而这两者都是环境的设计选择。 将推理与工具调用交替进行的模型会根据观察结果修正路线（Yao et al., 2022）；模型可以学习何时以及如何调用工具（Schick et al., 2023）；关于工具学习的综述梳理了接口所呈现的各种形式（Qin et al., 2025）；来自执行的反馈让模型能够修复自己的输出（Chen et al., 2024b）；而在软件工程中，智能体与计算机之间接口的设计，连同简洁的反馈和防护栏，决定了同一个模型所能取得的成果（Yang et al., 2024）。 模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）将应用程序向模型提供工具、资源和提示的方式标准化（Model Context Protocol, 2025），而服务器生态系统则引发了安全与维护方面的问题（Hou et al., 2025）。 对于模型初次接触的记法，本文的发现将可学习性问题转化为关于反馈通道的问题，即一页包含检查器消息的参考资料是否足以支撑有效的模型，以及一份技能文档和由模型调用的工具能带来什么增益，其以 token 计的代价又是多少。 本研究通过在同一个评判者下把这两个通道视为同一设计的两种条件来回答该问题。

paragraphs.en: Process mining reads logs and writes models, and a notation that holds the model and its simulation parameters in one text can stand at both ends of the loop. Discovery derives a model from an event log and conformance checking replays a log on a model ( van der Aalst, 2016 ) , with XES as the standard format for logs ( IEEE, 2016 ) , and discovered models are judged by fitness, precision, generalisation and simplicity ( Buijs et al., 2014 ) , with a benchmark of discovery algorithms on public logs ( Augusto et al., 2019 ) . The inductive miner discovers block-structured sound models which fit the log ( Leemans et al., 2013 ) , token-based replay measures fitness by replaying traces on a Petri net ( Berti and van der Aalst, 2021 ) , PM4Py implements discovery, conformance checking and the conversion between BPMN and Petri nets ( Berti et al., 2023 ) , and business process simulation produces logs from models with durations, resources and branching probabilities, with simulation models discovered from logs in turn ( Chapela-Campa et al., 2025 ) . The position at both ends sets two tests for tok, whether the simulated log fits the source model under replay and whether a discovered model reads back into the notation, and the demonstration of the study applies both tests with PM4Py as the independent tool.
paragraphs.zh: 过程挖掘读取日志并写出模型，而一种能在同一份文本中同时容纳模型及其仿真参数的表示法，可以同时位于这一循环的两端。 发现是从事件日志中推导出模型，符合性检查则是在模型上重放日志（van der Aalst, 2016），XES 是日志的标准格式（IEEE, 2016），发现的模型以适应性、精确性、泛化性和简洁性来评判（Buijs et al., 2014），并且已有在公开日志上对发现算法的基准测试（Augusto et al., 2019）。 归纳挖掘器能发现与日志契合的块结构可靠模型（Leemans et al., 2013），基于令牌的重放通过在 Petri 网上重放轨迹来度量适应性（Berti and van der Aalst, 2021），PM4Py 实现了发现、符合性检查以及 BPMN 与 Petri 网之间的转换（Berti et al., 2023），而业务过程仿真则根据包含时长、资源和分支概率的模型生成日志，仿真模型反过来也可以从日志中发现（Chapela-Campa et al., 2025）。 位于两端这一位置为 tok 设定了两项测试：仿真日志在重放下是否与源模型契合，以及发现的模型能否被该表示法读回；本研究的演示使用 PM4Py 作为独立工具来执行这两项测试。

paragraphs.en: The process elements of tok follow the BPMN metamodel one to one ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) . Events are written start , end , catch , throw and boundary , with triggers as attributes ( message , timer , signal , error , escalation , condition , link , compensate , terminate ). Activities are written by their task type ( task , user , manual , service , script , rule , send , receive , call ) or as sub-processes ( sub , adhoc , eventsub , transaction ) with an indented block. Gateways are written xor , and , or , eventgw and complex . A flow statement chains sequence flows ( flow a -> b -> c ) and carries a label, a FEEL condition ( when= ) or the default flag, while a message statement draws a message flow between pools. Data objects, data stores, item definitions, conversations, choreographies, correlation keys and annotations complete the vocabulary of BPMN 2.0.2.
paragraphs.zh: tok 的流程元素与 BPMN 元模型一一对应（Object Management Group, 2014）。 事件写作 start、end、catch、throw 和 boundary，触发器作为属性（message、timer、signal、error、escalation、condition、link、compensate、terminate）。 活动按其任务类型（task、user、manual、service、script、rule、send、receive、call）书写，或以缩进块的形式写作子流程（sub、adhoc、eventsub、transaction）。 网关写作 xor、and、or、eventgw 和 complex。 flow 语句串联顺序流（flow a -> b -> c），并可带有标签、FEEL 条件（when=）或默认标志，而 message 语句则在池之间绘制消息流。 数据对象、数据存储、项定义、会话、编排、关联键和注释补全了 BPMN 2.0.2 的词汇表。

paragraphs.en: Decisions are written in the same document as the process, where a decision statement holds a DMN decision table as rows of cells, a boxed context, a list, an invocation of a business knowledge model, or a literal FEEL expression, and inputdata , bkm and source statements form the decision requirements graph of DMN 1.5. paragraphs.en: tok is a declarative, domain-specific textual notation ( Mernik et al., 2005 ) with a context-free syntax and decidable context conditions, given a translational semantics through the BPMN 2.0.2 and DMN 1.5 metamodels. The classification places the notation in four fields, one field per paragraph, because each field explains a different property of the design, and together the four fields explain why a notation built for people serves language models as well.
paragraphs.zh: tok 是一种声明式的、面向特定领域的文本表示法（Mernik 等，2005），具有与上下文无关的语法和可判定的上下文条件，并通过 BPMN 2.0.2 与 DMN 1.5 元模型获得了翻译语义。 该分类将这种表示法置于四个领域之中，每段对应一个领域，因为每个领域解释的是设计的一个不同属性，而这四个领域合在一起则解释了为什么一种为人类构建的表示法同样也能很好地服务于语言模型。

paragraphs.en: In formal language theory, the syntax of tok is line-oriented with blocks marked by indentation, after the offside rule of Landin (1966) . Indentation makes the syntax of tok sensitive to the column of each line, a property beyond the reach of a context-free grammar over characters. A lexer that turns changes of indentation into block-opening and block-closing tokens yields a token language that is context-free in the hierarchy of Chomsky (1956) , and a deterministic top-down parser reads the token language in one pass. Unique identifiers, resolved references and the rules of BPMN 2.0.2 are context conditions over the parse tree, in the sense of attribute grammars ( Knuth, 1968 ) , so that every condition is decidable and the time the engine needs to check all conditions grows at most linearly with the size of a model. Expressions are delegated to FEEL, an embedded sublanguage with its own grammar. Execution and simulation are separate interpretations of the same text.
paragraphs.zh: 在形式语言理论中，tok 的语法是面向行的，仿照 Landin（1966）的越界规则，用缩进来标记块。 缩进使 tok 的语法对每一行的列位置敏感，这一性质超出了字符上的上下文无关文法的表达能力。 将缩进变化转换为块开启和块闭合词法单元的词法分析器，会产生一种在 Chomsky（1956）的层次结构中属于上下文无关的词法单元语言，而确定性的自顶向下解析器可以一遍读完这种词法单元语言。 唯一标识符、引用解析以及 BPMN 2.0.2 的规则是关于解析树的上下文条件，其意义遵循属性文法（Knuth, 1968），因此每个条件都是可判定的，且引擎检查所有条件所需的时间至多随模型规模线性增长。 表达式委托给 FEEL 处理，它是一种拥有自身文法的嵌入式子语言。 执行与仿真是对同一文本的两种相互独立的解释。

paragraphs.en: In model-driven engineering, tok is an alternative concrete syntax for an existing abstract syntax, the construction which language workbenches such as Xtext and MontiCore support for textual languages ( Eysholdt and Behrens, 2010 ; Krahn et al., 2010 ) and which text-based modelling recommends for the sake of versioning, differencing and tooling ( Grönniger et al., 2014 ) . The BPMN and DMN metamodels define the abstract syntax, the BPMN diagram and the BPMN XML file are two standard concrete syntaxes of the metamodels, and tok is a third concrete syntax of the same metamodels. The meaning of a tok document is the meaning of the BPMN and DMN models compiled from the document. A notation over an existing metamodel keeps the standard model as the reference and makes an exact translation in both directions possible, in which an imported BPMN file prints as tok and compiles back to a BPMN file with the same semantic content.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型驱动工程中，tok 是现有抽象语法的一种替代具体语法，这种构造是 Xtext 和 MontiCore 等语言工作台为文本语言所支持的（Eysholdt and Behrens, 2010; Krahn et al., 2010），也是基于文本的建模出于版本控制、差异比较和工具支持的目的所推荐的（Grönniger et al., 2014）。 BPMN 和 DMN 元模型定义了抽象语法，BPMN 图和 BPMN XML 文件是该元模型的两种标准具体语法，而 tok 是同一元模型的第三种具体语法。 tok 文档的含义就是由该文档编译而成的 BPMN 和 DMN 模型的含义。 建立在现有元模型之上的表示法以标准模型为参照，并使双向的精确翻译成为可能，即导入的 BPMN 文件打印为 tok，并可编译回具有相同语义内容的 BPMN 文件。

paragraphs.en: In semiotics, the BPMN diagram, the BPMN XML file and the tok text are three expression planes of one content plane, the metamodel, in the terms of Hjelmslev (1961) . The diagram is largely iconic, a picture whose spatial relations stand for the relations of the process, while the tok text is symbolic, a code of conventional signs for the same relations ( Peirce, 1931 ) . Compiling tok to a diagram is an intersemiotic translation, from one sign system to another of a different kind, and compiling tok to XML is a translation between two codes of the same kind ( Jakobson, 1959 ) . tok is built as a notational system in the sense of Goodman (1976) , in which the characters of the notation are disjoint and finitely differentiated and every canonical text has one model. The analog part of a drawing, the position of every shape, moves to a separate layout file, so the tok text keeps only the notational part of the model. In the division of Morris (1938) , the grammar of tok is its syntactics, the BPMN meaning its semantics, and the diagnostics, the canonical form and the documents for language-model applications its pragmatics, the design for the users of the notation.
paragraphs.zh: 在符号学中，按照叶尔姆斯列夫（1961）的术语，BPMN 图、BPMN XML 文件和 tok 文本是一个内容平面——即元模型——的三个表达平面。 图在很大程度上是图像性的，是一幅其空间关系代表过程关系的图画，而 tok 文本则是象征性的，是一套表示同样关系的约定符号代码（皮尔士，1931）。 将 tok 编译为图是一种符际翻译，即从一个符号系统到另一个不同种类的符号系统的翻译；而将 tok 编译为 XML 则是同类两种代码之间的翻译（雅各布森，1959）。tok 是按照古德曼（1976）意义上的标记系统构建的，其中标记的字符互不相交且有限可区分，并且每个规范文本都只有一个模型。 图纸中类似模拟信号的部分，即每个图形的位置，被移到单独的布局文件中，因此 tok 文本只保留模型的标记性部分。 按照莫里斯（1938）的划分，tok 的语法是它的符形学，其 BPMN 含义是它的语义学，而诊断信息、规范形式以及面向语言-模型应用的文档则是它的语用学，即为该标记系统的用户所做的设计。

paragraphs.en: Notation research and the theory of communication supply the criteria for the pragmatic choices. The Physics of Notations judges visual notations by principles such as semiotic clarity and perceptual discriminability ( Moody, 2009 ) , and the cognitive dimensions of Green and Petre (1996) judge textual and visual notations alike by dimensions which include viscosity, the resistance of a notation to change, hidden dependencies, and progressive evaluation, the possibility to check work at every stage. tok lowers the viscosity of a model, since an edit of one line changes one line, makes the dependencies of a flow visible in the flow statement, and gives progressive evaluation through a checker which answers every text in about 20 milliseconds.
paragraphs.zh: 记法研究与传播理论为语用选择提供了准则。 记法物理学以符号清晰度和感知可辨别性等原则来评价可视化记法（Moody, 2009），而 Green 和 Petre（1996）的认知维度则以若干维度来评价文本记法与可视化记法，这些维度包括黏性（即记法对变更的阻力）、隐藏依赖以及渐进式求值（即在每一阶段检查工作的可能性）。tok 降低了模型的黏性，因为编辑一行只改变一行，使数据流的依赖关系在流语句中可见，并通过一个能在约 20 毫秒内对每段文本作出响应的检查器提供渐进式求值。

sents.en: The Physics of Notations judges visual notations by principles such as semiotic clarity and perceptual discriminability ( Moody, 2009 ) , and the cognitive dimensions of Green and Petre (1996) judge textual and visual notations alike by dimensions which include viscosity, the resistance of a notation to change, hidden dependencies, and progressive evaluation, the possibility to check work at every stage. tok lowers the viscosity of a model, since an edit of one line changes one line, makes the dependencies of a flow visible in the flow statement, and gives progressive evaluation through a checker which answers every text in about 20 milliseconds.
sents.zh: 记法物理学以符号清晰度和感知可辨别性等原则来评价可视化记法（Moody, 2009），而 Green 和 Petre（1996）的认知维度则以若干维度来评价文本记法与可视化记法，这些维度包括黏性（即记法对变更的阻力）、隐藏依赖以及渐进式求值（即在每一阶段检查工作的可能性）。tok 降低了模型的黏性，因为编辑一行只改变一行，使数据流的依赖关系在流语句中可见，并通过一个能在约 20 毫秒内对每段文本作出响应的检查器提供渐进式求值。

paragraphs.en: In the account of grounding by Clark and Brennan (1991) , two parties reach a shared understanding by exchanging evidence of understanding at the least collaborative effort, and a party which receives evidence of a misunderstanding repairs the utterance at the point which the evidence names. The checker of tok supplies such evidence for every text in the form of a diagnostic with a code, a line and an element, to a person in an editor and to a language model in a loop alike, and the line-oriented syntax keeps the evidence local, since a statement occupies one line and a reference names one identifier. The repair of a fault therefore touches one line, a property which research on error messages for programmers ties to the usefulness of a message ( Marceau et al., 2011 ; Becker et al., 2019 ) . In the terms of Hutchins et al. (1985) , a localised diagnostic narrows the gulf of evaluation, the distance between the state of the system and the understanding of the user, which for a person means a visible fault in the editor and for a language model means a short message to answer. The reference condition of the study measures how much grounding one page of reference and the messages of the checker give a model which has never seen the notation, and the agent condition measures what a skill document and tools called by the model add. A process model in tok is a boundary object in the sense of Star and Griesemer (1989) , a text with enough structure to be read by analysts, students, process engines through the exported BPMN, and language models, and with enough plasticity to be written by each of them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Clark 和 Brennan（1991）的奠基（grounding）理论中，双方通过以最小的协作代价交换理解证据来达成共同理解，而收到误解证据的一方会在证据所指出的位置对话语进行修复。 tok 的检查器为每段文本以诊断的形式提供此类证据，诊断包含代码、行号和元素，无论对编辑器中的人还是对循环中的语言模型都一样，而面向行的语法使证据保持局部性，因为一条语句占一行，一个引用指名一个标识符。 因此对故障的修复只涉及一行，关于程序员错误消息的研究将这一特性与消息的有用性联系起来（Marceau 等，2011；Becker 等，2019）。 用 Hutchins 等人 （1985）的话说，局部化的诊断缩小了评估鸿沟，即系统状态与用户理解之间的距离，这对人来说意味着编辑器中可见的故障，对语言模型来说意味着一条简短的可回答消息。 该研究的参照条件衡量一页参考资料和检查器的消息能给予一个从未见过该记法的模型多少奠基，而智能体条件衡量技能文档和由模型调用的工具所增加的内容。 tok 中的过程模型是 Star 和 Griesemer（1989）意义上的边界对象，即一种文本，它具有足够的结构，可被分析师、学生、通过导出的 BPMN 的流程引擎以及语言模型阅读，又具有足够的可塑性，可由它们中的每一个编写。

paragraphs.en: The engine is written once, in Rust ( Matsakis and Klock, 2014 ) , and every interface calls the same library ( Figure 2 ). The command-line program tok offers the operations check , fmt , bpmn , svg , export , import , sim and eval . The language server gives an editor the diagnostics, the canonical form, completion, hover information and an outline through the Language Server Protocol ( Microsoft, 2026 ) , and a VS Code extension uses the language server. The WebAssembly build ( Haas et al., 2017 ) runs the engine in the browser playground. The packages for Python and R bind the library as native extensions, the Julia package calls the library through its C interface, and the MCP server offers the operations as tools to language-model applications. One implementation gives one behaviour, so that a diagnostic has the same code, line and message in the editor, in R, in the browser and through MCP.
paragraphs.zh: 引擎用 Rust（Matsakis and Klock, 2014）编写一次，所有接口都调用同一个库（图 2）。 命令行程序 tok 提供 check、fmt、bpmn、svg、export、import、sim 和 eval 等操作。 语言服务器通过语言服务器协议（Microsoft, 2026）向编辑器提供诊断、规范形式、补全、悬停信息和大纲，并且一个 VS Code 扩展使用了该语言服务器。 WebAssembly 构建（Haas et al., 2017）在浏览器演练场中运行引擎。 Python 和 R 的包将该库绑定为原生扩展，Julia 包通过其 C 接口调用该库，而 MCP 服务器将这些操作作为工具提供给语言模型应用。 一种实现提供一种行为，因此同一诊断在编辑器中、在 R 中、在浏览器中以及通过 MCP 都具有相同的代码、行号和消息。

paragraphs.en: The checker reports layered diagnostics, whose layers are tokens, statements, references, the rules of BPMN 2.0.2 with their clauses ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) , the profile of Camunda 8 ( Camunda, 2026 ) , decisions, FEEL expressions ( Object Management Group, 2024 ) and simulation parameters. Every diagnostic carries a code, a severity (error, warning or note), the line, the element and a message in English or Polish. Errors stop the export, and warnings mark a model that compiles to valid XML but breaks a rule of the standard. The interlibrary-loan document without the flow from locate to located gives the two warnings of the following check.
paragraphs.zh: 检查器报告分层诊断，其层次为词元、语句、引用、带有条款的 BPMN 2.0.2 规则（Object Management Group, 2014）、Camunda 8 的概要（Camunda, 2026）、决策、FEEL 表达式（Object Management Group, 2024）以及仿真参数。 每条诊断都带有代码、严重级别（错误、警告或提示）、行号、元素以及英文或波兰文的消息。 错误会中止导出，而警告标记的是能够编译为有效 XML 但违反了标准某条规则的模型。 没有从 locate 到 located 流程的馆际互借文档会给出下述检查的两条警告。

paragraphs.en: The importer reads BPMN and DMN files and prints the files as tok. The geometry of an imported drawing goes to a layout file beside the text, and the exporters reuse the drawing when the layout file is present, so a model drawn in a graphical tool keeps its drawing through the round trip while the tok text holds only the model. The canonical form, printed by tok fmt , gives one text per model and clean differences under version control.
paragraphs.zh: 导入器读取 BPMN 和 DMN 文件，并将这些文件打印为 tok 格式。 导入的绘图几何信息会保存到文本旁边的布局文件中，当布局文件存在时，导出器会复用该绘图，因此用图形工具绘制的模型在往返转换中能保留其绘图，而 tok 文本仅包含模型本身。 由 tok fmt 打印的规范形式为每个模型生成一份文本，并在版本控制下产生清晰的差异。

paragraphs.en: The study answers six numbered questions about tok. Question 1 asks how many fewer tokens a model takes in tok than in BPMN XML or DMN XML, and what the conversion of tool files to tok keeps. The second question, Question 2, is whether the tok checker finds injected modelling faults that the XML validators find and points to the faulty element, while Question 3 asks whether language models write valid process models in tok as often as in BPMN XML, with how many tokens and how faithful to the text, from a one-page reference and as agents with tools. Process mining is the subject of Question 4, with tok as the generator of an event log from a model and as the reader of a discovered model, and Questions 5 and 6 ask how fast the engine is and whether the released engine passes its conformance suites.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究回答了关于 tok 的六个编号问题。 问题 1 询问模型在 tok 中比在 BPMN XML 或 DMN XML 中少读取多少 token，以及将工具文件转换为 tok 时保留了什么。 第二个问题即问题 2，是 tok 检查器能否发现 XML 校验器能发现的注入建模错误并指出错误元素；问题 3 则询问语言模型在从一页参考资料出发以及作为带工具的智能体的情况下，用 tok 编写有效过程模型的频率是否与用 BPMN XML 相同，以及使用多少 token 和对文本的忠实程度。 问题 4 的主题是过程挖掘，其中 tok 作为从模型生成事件日志的工具，也作为读取所发现模型的工具；问题 5 和问题 6 询问引擎的速度有多快，以及发布的引擎是否通过其一致性测试套件。

paragraphs.en: The study uses two frozen releases of tok, both published with archived binaries ( Deja, 2026b ) . Release 1.0.2 serves the size measurement, the fault injection and the reference condition of the language-model study. paragraphs.en: The size measurement counts characters, bytes and the tokens of five open subword tokenizers of the byte-pair kind ( Sennrich et al., 2016 ) , namely o200k and cl100k of tiktoken ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Qwen3, DeepSeek-V3 and Mistral NeMo. For corpus N the measurement compares the tok text with the standard files that the engine exports, with and without diagrams, as written and minified. For corpora V, R and C the measurement compares the file as exported by the tool, the file without the diagram, and the smallest standard BPMN of the same model (without the diagram, without vendor extensions, minified) with the tok text that tok import writes. The ratio of XML tokens to tok tokens is computed per file and summarised by the geometric mean with a 95 % bootstrap interval (10 000 resamples of files, seed 20261029), the median and the quartiles.
paragraphs.zh: 规模度量统计字符数、字节数以及五种开放的字节对（byte-pair）类子词分词器的词元数（Sennrich et al., 2016），即 tiktoken 的 o200k 与 cl100k（OpenAI, 2026）、Qwen3、DeepSeek-V3 和 Mistral NeMo。 对于语料库 N，度量将 tok 文本与引擎导出的标准文件进行比较，包含带图与不带图、原样输出与压缩输出等形式。 对于语料库 V、R 和 C，度量将工具导出的文件、去掉图的文件以及同一模型的最小标准 BPMN（不带图、不含厂商扩展、压缩形式）与 tok 导入所写出的 tok 文本进行比较。 XML 词元数与 tok 词元数之比按文件逐一计算，并用几何均值结合 95% 自助法区间（对文件进行 10 000 次重抽样，随机种子 20261029）、中位数和四分位数进行汇总。

paragraphs.en: The fidelity measurement reads the original file and the BPMN file that tok writes back after the import with an independent reader built on lxml. The reader compares the kinds of flow nodes, the names, the sequence flows, the pools, the lanes and the message flows. A file whose import has checker errors only because the tool marked the process as executable is exported again with the executable mark removed, and both routes are reported.

paragraphs.en: The fault injection starts from the 85 models of corpus N with a start event, an end event and at least four flow nodes. Thirteen operators inject one fault each, namely a flow to an undefined node, a duplicate identifier, a missing start event, a missing end event, a disconnected activity, an exclusive split without conditions or a default, an exclusive split joined by a parallel join, a boundary event on an undefined activity, a start event with an incoming flow, an end event with an outgoing flow, a sequence flow between two pools, a malformed condition and a flow from an activity to itself. Every operator edits the tok text and, as the same edit, the semantic BPMN XML of the unmodified model, at the first, middle and last applicable element, which gives 1 411 faulty variants in all. The validators are tok check at the full level, the OMG XML Schema ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) , bpmnlint with its correctness rules and bpmnlint with its recommended rules ( bpmn.io, 2026 ) . A fault is detected when a validator reports a new error, signalled when the validator reports a new error or a new warning, and localised when a new diagnostic names the edited element or points to its line. Intervals of the overall rates come from resampling base models.
paragraphs.zh: 故障注入从语料库 N 的 85 个模型开始，这些模型具有开始事件、结束事件和至少四个流程节点。 十三个算子各注入一种故障，即：指向未定义节点的流、重复的标识符、缺失的开始事件、缺失的结束事件、断开的活动、没有条件或默认分支的排他网关、由并行汇聚连接的排他网关、位于未定义活动上的边界事件、带有入向流的开始事件、带有出向流的结束事件、两个池之间的顺序流、格式错误的条件，以及从活动指向其自身的流。 每个算子都会编辑 tok 文本，并作为同一次编辑同时编辑未修改模型的语义 BPMN XML，编辑位置为第一个、中间一个和最后一个适用的元素，总共得到 1 411 个故障变体。 校验器为完整级别的 tok check、OMG XML Schema（Object Management Group, 2014）、启用其正确性规则的 bpmnlint，以及启用其推荐规则的 bpmnlint（bpmn.io, 2026）。 当校验器报告一个新错误时，称该故障被检测到；当校验器报告一个新错误或新警告时，称该故障被信号化；当新的诊断信息指明了被编辑的元素或指向其所在行时，称该故障被定位。 总体比率的区间来自对基础模型的重采样。

paragraphs.en: Four language models that work as agents with tools write the models, which are Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 through the Claude command line, and the open-weight models gpt-oss 120B and Beam through the Ollama service. Each model writes a process model for each text in six arms, which cross the two representations with three conditions. In the condition reference the model gets a one-page reference of the representation with one worked example, the answer is checked, the messages are sent back, and the model has at most four attempts; the check of BPMN XML is the OMG XML Schema ( Object Management Group, 2014 ) , the correctness rules of bpmnlint ( bpmn.io, 2026 ) and a minimum of structure, and the check of tok is tok check of release 1.0.2, whose errors and warnings are sent back. In the two agent conditions the model gets a skill document as its system prompt, calls tools of the MCP server of tok 1.0.3 as often as the model decides, and has at most 12 model calls. In the condition agent, distributed skill the skill is the skill document distributed with tok 1.0.3 for the representation: for tok, a document of about 1 950 words which names the tools check , fmt and reference , through which the model reads the one-page reference, the specification or the list of diagnostics; for BPMN XML, a document of about 1 630 words which names the tool check_bpmn , lets the model justify a warning in place of fixing it, and gets the one-page reference of BPMN XML in place of the reference files of the skill. In the condition agent, lean skill the skill is a document of five steps and about 180 words, the same for both representations up to the names of the elements and of the tool, which carries the one-page reference of the representation, names one checker tool ( check for tok, check_bpmn for BPMN XML) and asks the model to fix every error and every warning before answering. Every arm uses the same instruction, which asks for one pool, one lane per actor, tasks named with the words of the text, gateways for decisions and parallel work, and a start and an end event on every path. The XML arms ask for the semantic model without the diagram, the cheapest correct XML. The language models know BPMN XML from their training and meet tok for the first time in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 四个作为带工具智能体工作的语言模型来撰写模型，其中 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 Claude Sonnet 5.5 通过 Claude 命令行运行，开放权重模型 gpt-oss 120B 和 Beam 通过 Ollama 服务运行。 每个模型为六个臂中的每个文本撰写一个过程模型，这六个臂将两种表示与三种条件交叉组合。 在 reference 条件中，模型获得该表示的一页参考及一个已解答示例，答案会被检查，消息被发回，模型最多有四次尝试；BPMN XML 的检查依据是 OMG XML Schema（Object Management Group, 2014）、bpmnlint 的正确性规则（bpmn.io, 2026）以及最低结构要求；tok 的检查是 1.0.2 版本的 tok check，其错误和警告会被发回。 在两个智能体条件中，模型获得一份技能文档作为其系统提示词，按模型自身决定调用 tok 1.0.3 的 MCP 服务器工具，且最多有 12 次模型调用。 在 agent, distributed skill 条件中，技能是随 tok 1.0.3 分发的针对该表示的技能文档：对于 tok，是一份约 1950 词的文档，其中列出了工具 check、fmt 和 reference，模型通过这些工具读取一页参考、规范或诊断列表；对于 BPMN XML，是一份约 1630 词的文档，其中列出了工具 check_bpmn，允许模型以说明理由代替修复某个警告，并以 BPMN XML 的一页参考取代技能的参考文件。 在 agent, lean skill 条件中，技能是一份包含五个步骤、约 180 词的文档，除元素名称和工具名称外对两种表示完全相同，其中附有该表示的一页参考，列出一个检查工具（tok 用 check，BPMN XML 用 check_bpmn），并要求模型在作答前修复每个错误和每个警告。 每个臂使用相同的指令，该指令要求一个池、每位参与者一个泳道、以文本中的词语命名的任务、用于决策和并行工作的网关，以及每条路径上的开始和结束事件。 XML 臂要求不带图示的语义模型，即最简的正确 XML。 这些语言模型在训练中已了解 BPMN XML，但在提示中首次接触 tok。

paragraphs.en: One judge scores every final model on BPMN XML, which for tok is the BPMN file that tok bpmn writes from the answer and for XML the answer itself. A model is valid when the file is well-formed and valid against the OMG schema, has no error of the bpmnlint correctness rules, has a start and an end event, and has only flows between known nodes. The judge is independent of the tok checker. The cost of a run is the number of input and output tokens reported by the provider for all calls of the run, including cache reads and cache writes for the Claude models, and the wall time. The fidelity of a valid model compares the model with the gold standard of the text, in that activity names are matched one to one by the Hungarian method ( Kuhn, 1955 ) on a token-set similarity of at least 0.5 computed with RapidFuzz ( RapidFuzz contributors, 2026 ) , and flow F1 compares the ordering of activities through gateways and events in the model with the gold ordering. The gold ordering of a PET text comes from the expert annotation, and the gold ordering of a PMo text from the BPMN model of the dataset. The three primary outcomes are validity, total tokens per run and flow F1 with an invalid model scored 0.
paragraphs.zh: 一位评审者对每个最终模型在 BPMN XML 上打分，其中对 tok 而言该 XML 是 tok bpmn 从答案写出的 BPMN 文件，对 XML 而言则是答案本身。 当文件格式良好且符合 OMG 模式、没有违反 bpmnlint 正确性规则的错误、具有开始事件和结束事件，并且只包含已知节点之间的流时，该模型即为有效。 该评审者独立于 tok 检查器。 一次运行的成本是提供方报告的该运行所有调用的输入和输出 token 数量，包括 Claude 模型的缓存读取和缓存写入，以及墙钟时间。 有效模型的保真度将模型与文本的黄金标准进行比较，其中活动名称通过 Hungarian 方法（Kuhn, 1955）基于使用 RapidFuzz（RapidFuzz contributors, 2026）计算的不低于 0.5 的 token 集合相似度进行一对一匹配，而流 F1 则将模型中经由网关和事件的活动顺序与黄金顺序进行比较。 PET 文本的黄金顺序来自专家标注，PMo 文本的黄金顺序来自数据集的 BPMN 模型。 三个主要结局指标是有效性、每次运行的总 token 数以及流 F1，无效模型得分为 0。

paragraphs.en: The analysis compares the arms within each model and dataset, with the text as the unit. For each text the outcome is averaged over the repetitions of an arm. The four primary comparisons are tok, reference against BPMN XML, reference (the representation under the reference condition), tok, agent, lean skill against BPMN XML, agent, lean skill (the representation under the same skill), tok, agent, lean skill against tok, agent, distributed skill (the skill design within tok), and tok, agent, lean skill against tok, reference (the agent loop against the reference loop within tok). Each comparison reports the mean difference with a 95 % bootstrap interval (10 000 resamples of texts, seed 20261029) and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ; Efron, 1979 ) . Holm’s procedure adjusts the p p values of the 96 primary tests together (four models, two datasets, four comparisons, three outcomes) ( Holm, 1979 ) . The remaining pairs of arms, among them the two distributed skills against each other, are reported with the same intervals and without a test.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析以文本为单位，在每个模型和数据集内对各个实验臂进行比较。 对每条文本，其结果在某个实验臂的多次重复上取平均。 四项主要比较是：tok, reference 对比 BPMN XML, reference（参考条件下的表示）；tok, agent, lean skill 对比 BPMN XML, agent, lean skill（同一技能下的表示）；tok, agent, lean skill 对比 tok, agent, distributed skill（tok 内的技能设计对比）；以及 tok, agent, lean skill 对比 tok, reference（tok 内的智能体循环对比参考循环）。 每项比较报告均值差及其 95% 自助法区间（对文本进行 10 000 次重采样，种子为 20261029），并报告 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Wilcoxon, 1945；Efron, 1979）。 Holm 程序对 96 项主要检验（四个模型、两个数据集、四项比较、三种结果）的 p p 值进行联合调整（Holm, 1979）。 其余的实验臂配对，其中包括两个分布式技能之间的对比，以相同的区间报告，但不进行检验。

paragraphs.en: The process-mining demonstration takes the 48 BPMN models of the PMo dataset. For each model, tok import reads the BPMN file and a fixed rule adds the simulation (every activity takes an exponential duration with a mean of 10 minutes, every flow leaving an exclusive gateway without a condition takes an equal share of probability, every flow leaving an inclusive gateway a probability of 0.5, and 500 cases arrive with exponential gaps of one hour on average, seed 20261031), after which tok sim writes the event log as XES. PM4Py replays the log on the original BPMN file converted to a Petri net, by token-based replay ( Berti and van der Aalst, 2021 ) , and reports fitness and precision. The inductive miner of PM4Py ( Leemans et al., 2013 ) , with a noise threshold of 0, discovers a model from the log and writes the model as BPMN. tok import reads the discovered file, tok check checks the imported model, and tok bpmn writes the model again for a comparison of the round trip. The ordering of activities of the discovered model is compared with the ordering of the original model by precision, recall and F1. PM4Py also reads the BPMN file that tok bpmn writes from each simulation model, and the demonstration records how many sequence flows PM4Py finds.
paragraphs.zh: 流程挖掘演示采用 PMo 数据集的 48 个 BPMN 模型。 对于每个模型，tok import 读取 BPMN 文件，一条固定规则添加模拟设置（每个活动的持续时间服从均值为 10 分钟的指数分布，每条从排他网关离开且不带条件的流均分概率，每条从包容网关离开的流概率为 0.5，500 个案例以平均间隔一小时的指数分布到达，随机种子 20261031），之后 tok sim 将事件日志写为 XES。 PM4Py 通过基于令牌的重放（Berti and van der Aalst, 2021），将日志在转换为 Petri 网的原始 BPMN 文件上重放，并报告适应度和精确度。 PM4Py 的归纳式挖掘器（Leemans et al., 2013）以噪声阈值 0 从日志中发现一个模型，并将该模型写为 BPMN。tok import 读取发现的文件，tok check 检查导入的模型，tok bpmn 再次写出该模型，以便比较往返转换的结果。 通过精确率、召回率和 F1，将发现模型的活动排序与原始模型的活动排序进行比较。 PM4Py 还读取 tok bpmn 从每个模拟模型写出的 BPMN 文件，演示记录 PM4Py 找到的序列流数量。

paragraphs.en: A model in tok takes two to four times fewer tokens than the smallest standard XML of the same model, and six to twelve times fewer than XML with a diagram ( Table 2 ). For the 893 files that 37 tools exported for the MIWG test suite, the geometric mean ratio is 2.18 (95 % interval 2.15–2.21) against the smallest standard BPMN and 7.71 (7.48–7.96) against the files as exported. For the 93 tok models of the project, the standard files that the engine exports take 3.90 times the tokens of the tok text without diagrams and 11.42 times with diagrams. paragraphs.en: The four language models write valid models in every arm except the two BPMN XML agent arms of Beam, and the arms differ in reliability for the weaker models and in tokens for every model ( Tables 4 and 3 ). In BPMN XML from the one-page reference, every model writes a valid model for every text of both sets. In tok from the one-page reference, the share of valid models is 97.6 and 95.6 % for Claude Haiku 5.5 on PET and PMo, 98.8 and 100 % for Claude Sonnet 5.5, 96.4 and 93.3 % for Beam, and 85.7 and 91.1 % for gpt-oss 120B. As agents with the lean skill and one checker tool, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 write a valid model for every text of both sets in both representations, gpt-oss 120B for 97.6 and 97.8 % of the texts in tok and for 97.6 and 100 % in BPMN XML, and Beam for 100 and 97.8 % in tok. With the distributed skills, the agents in tok reach 95.6 to 100 % for Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Beam and 88.1 and 88.9 % for gpt-oss 120B, and the agents in BPMN XML reach 100 % for Claude Haiku 5.5, 83.3 and 93.3 % for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and 73.8 and 75.6 % for gpt-oss 120B, since the distributed BPMN skill lets the model justify a warning in place of a fix, and the final models of Claude Sonnet 5.5 keep a branch without a condition next to a default flow in 7 and 3 runs, which bpmnlint counts as an error. After Holm’s adjustment over the 96 primary tests, the only significant differences in validity are the two comparisons of Beam in BPMN XML reported below, and the largest other difference among the primary tests, gpt-oss 120B in tok against BPMN XML from the reference on PET, is − 0.143 -0.143 (95 % interval − 0.238 -0.238 to − 0.060 -0.060 , p Holm = 0.64 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.64 ).

paragraphs.en: The simulated logs follow the original models, since 38 of the 47 logs, replayed by PM4Py on the original BPMN files, fit with fitness 1 and every trace replayable. In six further models the original BPMN file holds intermediate events, which leave no event in a log, and with the intermediate events bypassed in the BPMN file the same six logs fit with fitness 1 as well, so that the shortfall lies in the conversion of the events to the Petri net. One model has an event-based gateway whose events carry no wait in the simulation, and 251 of its 500 cases stop at the gateway. Two models join branches with inclusive or complex gateways, which PM4Py converts to Petri nets outside the class that alignments accept, and token-based replay gives fitness 0.96 and 0.92.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟日志与原始模型相符，因为在 47 个日志中，有 38 个日志经 PM4Py 在原始 BPMN 文件上重放后，适应度为 1，且每条轨迹均可重放。 在另外六个模型中，原始 BPMN 文件包含中间事件，这些事件在日志中不产生任何事件，而在 BPMN 文件中绕过这些中间事件后，同样这六个日志的适应度也达到 1，因此差距源于将事件转换为 Petri 网的过程。 有一个模型包含一个基于事件的网关，其事件在模拟中不包含等待，该模型 500 个案例中有 251 个停在该网关处。 有两个模型使用包含网关或复杂网关连接分支，PM4Py 将其转换为对齐（alignments）无法接受的 Petri 网，基于 token 的重放给出的适应度分别为 0.96 和 0.92。

paragraphs.en: tok reads the models that a process-mining tool discovers. The inductive miner discovers a model from each of the 47 logs with fitness 1 and a median precision of 0.947 (mean 0.902, minimum 0.417). tok imports all 47 discovered BPMN files without errors, and all 47 keep the kinds of their nodes and flows through the round trip from BPMN to tok and back. The tok check warnings of 46 discovered models are all W021, a branch of an exclusive split without a label, a condition or a default, since a discovered model carries no branch conditions. The ordering of activities in the discovered model agrees with the original model with a median F1 of 1.0 (mean 0.926, minimum 0.2).
paragraphs.zh: tok 读取流程挖掘工具发现的模型。 归纳式挖掘器（inductive miner）从 47 个日志中的每一个都发现了适配度（fitness）为 1、精确度中位数为 0.947（均值 0.902，最小值 0.417）的模型。tok 无错误地导入全部 47 个发现的 BPMN 文件，并且所有 47 个模型在从 BPMN 到 tok 再返回 BPMN 的往返过程中都保持了其节点和流的类型。 46 个被发现模型的 tok 检查警告全部为 W021，即不带标签、条件或默认值的一个排他分支，因为被发现的模型不携带分支条件。 被发现模型中的活动顺序与原始模型一致，F1 中位数为 1.0（均值 0.926，最小值 0.2）。

paragraphs.en: The size of a model decides what a language model pays for writing the model. A tok text takes about half of the tokens of the smallest standard BPMN of a file drawn in a tool and about an eighth of the tokens of the file as exported by the tool, so that a language model which writes tok spends its output on the content of the model. The saving shows in the study as fewer tokens per run for Claude Sonnet 5.5, the model with the shortest runs, whose output in tok is about a third of the output in BPMN XML on both sets of texts, and the direction of the saving agrees with the token reductions reported for compact representations of process models ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Köpke and Safan, 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 模型的大小决定了语言模型在编写模型时的付出。 一段 tok 文本所占的 token 数大约是用工具绘制的文件的最小标准 BPMN 的一半，大约是该工具导出文件的八分之一，因此编写 tok 的语言模型把其输出花费在模型的内容上。 这种节省在研究中体现为 Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次运行所需 token 更少，该模型的运行长度最短，其在两组文本上以 tok 形式的输出约为以 BPMN XML 形式输出的三分之一，且节省的方向与针对过程模型紧凑表示所报告的 token 缩减一致（Agrawal et al., 2026; Köpke and Safan, 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The capability of a language model decides what the model makes of tok. The four models learn tok from one page of reference and write valid tok for 85.7 to 100 % of the texts, in the manner in which a model translates an unseen language from a grammar book placed in its context, with a success that depends on the model ( Tanzer et al., 2024 ) , and writes code for an unseen library from the documentation of the library ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) . The knowledge of BPMN XML that the models bring from their training lets every model write valid BPMN XML for every text. Claude Sonnet 5.5 writes tok as reliably as BPMN XML, with fewer tokens and at about two fifths of the cost of a run in BPMN XML, whereas gpt-oss 120B needs more attempts in tok and writes valid tok for 85.7 and 91.1 % of the texts. paragraphs.en: The checker carries the knowledge of the standard to the writer of a model. paragraphs.en: For the theory of communication between people and language models, the study gives a measured case of grounding through an artefact, in the sense in which Clark and Brennan (1991) describe grounding as the exchange of evidence of understanding. One page of reference and the messages of a checker ground the strongest models in a notation which the models have never seen, at a cost in tokens below the cost of the format which the models know, and the agent loop grounds the same models through a tool at 1.8 to 3.2 times the tokens of the reference loop when the skill carries the reference and at 4.4 to 6.5 times when the skill sends the model to read the reference through a tool. The three conditions are grounding channels with different costs, and the diagnostics which every channel carries are local because the formal structure of the notation is local. The channel itself belongs to the ground, as the probe of Beam shows: the same document reaches the checker in every call when the tool names its parameter text and in few calls when the tool names the parameter xml , a property of the encoding of the call and of neither notation. A property of the grammar, one statement per line with named references, therefore appears in the data as a repair loop which ends after 1.2 to 2.3 attempts on average in the reference arms, the same kind of loop in which a model repairs code from the feedback of an execution ( Chen et al., 2024b ) or from a verbal signal about its previous attempt ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . The costs of the two channels belong in the comparison next to the validity, as the evaluation of agents requires ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . For the design of notations the same observation supports a rule, according to which a textual concrete syntax over an existing metamodel keeps every statement local and every reference named, because the checker then localises 99.7 % of the faults which the checker reports to the element or the line, and a writer, human or machine, repairs from the localisation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于人与语言模型之间传播的理论而言，本研究给出了一个经由人工制品达成接地的有分寸的案例，即 Clark 和 Brennan（1991）所描述的接地——相互交换理解证据的过程。 一页参考文献加上校验器的消息，就能以低于模型所熟悉格式的令牌成本，将最强的模型接地到它们从未见过的记法上；而智能体循环则通过工具将同样的模型接地，当技能自带参考文献时，其令牌消耗为参考文献循环的 1.8 到 3.2 倍，当技能让模型通过工具去读取参考文献时，则为 4.4 到 6.5 倍。 这三种通道是成本不同的接地通道，并且每种通道所承载的诊断都是局部的，因为该记法的形式结构是局部的。 通道本身属于接地的一部分，正如 Beam 的探针所示：当工具把参数命名为 text 时，同一文档在每次调用中都会送达校验器；而当工具把参数命名为 xml 时，则只在少数调用中送达——这是调用编码方式的属性，与两种记法本身都无关。 语法的一个属性——每行一条语句且引用带有名称——因此在数据中表现为一种修复循环：在参考文献组中，该循环平均在 1.2 到 2.3 次尝试后结束；这与模型根据执行反馈修复代码（Chen 等，2024b）或根据关于其先前尝试的言语信号进行修复（Madaan 等，2023；Shinn 等，2023）属于同一类循环。 这两条通道的成本应当像智能体评估所要求的那样（Kapoor 等，2025），与有效性一并纳入比较之中。 对于记法设计而言，同样的观察支持这样一条规则：在既有元模型之上采用文本式具体语法，可保持每条语句局部化且每个引用都带名称，因为这样校验器就能将其报告的 99.7% 的故障定位到具体元素或行，而无论是人类还是机器的撰写者都可以依据该定位进行修复。

paragraphs.en: For research on process modelling with language models, the study offers an instrument and a result. The instrument consists of a representation which the model writes and a person reads, a checker whose diagnostics feed back into the loop, a judge independent of the notation, and a run script which records every prompt, answer, model file and validator output, so that comparisons of representations, whose quality criteria differ from study to study ( Brissard et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Lauer et al., 2026 ) , gain a common judge and a public baseline with the cost of a run reported next to the validity ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . The result places the representation among the variables with measured effects, next to the model, the skill design and the feedback channel, since the same text costs the strongest model a third of its output, costs a weaker model more attempts, and costs every model 1.7 to 2.8 times more when the skill makes the model read the reference through a tool.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于语言模型的过程建模研究，本研究提供了一套工具和一个结果。 这套工具包括：模型书写、人类阅读的表示，一个将诊断结果反馈到循环中的检查器，一个独立于记法的评审，以及一个记录每次提示、回答、模型文件和验证器输出的运行脚本，从而让质量标准因研究而异的表示比较（Brissard et al., 2026；Agrawal et al., 2026；Lauer et al., 2026）获得一个共同的评审和一个公开基线，并在有效性旁边报告运行成本（Kapoor et al., 2025）。 该结果将表示置于具有实测效应的变量之中，与模型、技能设计和反馈通道并列，因为同一份文本会让最强模型损失三分之一的输出，让较弱的模型花费更多尝试次数，而当技能要求模型通过工具读取参考资料时，会让所有模型的成本增加1.7到2.8倍。

paragraphs.en: tok sits at both ends of process mining, in the sense that the simulator turns a model into an event log which a process-mining tool replays on the original model, and the importer turns a discovered model into a text which a person reads and a checker verifies. paragraphs.zh: tok 中的过程模型表现得如同文档一样，这改变了组织保存过程知识的方式。 文本进入版本控制，每次变更逐行显示差异——这正是基于文本的建模所主张的好处（Grönniger 等人，2014）——并进入评审和报告，以及语言模型的提示词，同时同一引擎将文本转换为建模工具和过程引擎所读取的文件，使模型、模型的评审和对模型的指令共享同一个制品。 以文本形式编写的模型对屏幕阅读器以及用文字代替图片工作的人也是开放的，对这些人而言，图表通常只能通过文字或触觉呈现来获取（King 等人，2004；Loitsch 和 Weber，2012）；这一主张依赖于记法的设计，相关用户研究仍有待开展。

paragraphs.en: The language-model study covers two sets of process descriptions in English, PET and PMo, and four language models, namely two Claude models of Anthropic and the open-weight models gpt-oss 120B and Beam. paragraphs.en: The agent conditions differ from the reference condition in several respects at once, which are the skill document, the tools, the loop controlled by the model, and release 1.0.3 of tok with four further warnings, and the two skill designs differ in the length of the skill and in the number of tools at once. paragraphs.en: tok is a plain-text notation for the content of BPMN 2.0.2 and DMN 1.5, with one engine that checks, compiles, imports and simulates models. The notation is an alternative concrete syntax of the standard metamodels, which keeps the translation to the standard exact in both directions, and a symbolic notational system which moves the geometry of a drawing out of the text, and the checker of the notation is a grounding channel whose evidence is local because the grammar is local. The study shows models two to four times smaller than the smallest standard XML, a checker that signals 98 % of injected faults, language models that learn tok from one page and write valid models for 85.7 to 100 % of the texts with fewer tokens for the strongest model, logs that fit their models, discovered models that tok reads back, and an engine that passes the conformance suites of DMN and of BPMN interchange. A person, a tool and a language model can therefore hold one process in one text, and the price of the shared text is measured for each of them.
paragraphs.zh: tok 是一种用于 BPMN 2.0.2 和 DMN 1.5 内容的纯文本表示法，配有单一引擎，可对模型进行检查、编译、导入和仿真。 该表示法是标准元模型的一种替代性具体语法，能在两个方向上保持与标准的精确转换；它还是一种符号化的记号体系，将图形的几何信息移出文本之外；该表示法的检查器是一个接地通道，由于语法是局部的，其证据也是局部的。 研究表明：模型比最小的标准 XML 小二到四倍；检查器能标记出 98% 的注入故障；语言模型从一页内容即可学会 tok，并为 85.7% 到 100% 的文本写出有效模型，其中最强的模型使用的 token 更少；日志能与其模型相匹配；被发现挖掘出的模型可被 tok 读回；引擎通过了 DMN 以及 BPMN 交换的一致性测试套件。 因此，人、工具和语言模型可以在一份文本中持有同一个流程，而这份共享文本的代价也针对其中每一方进行了测量。
